description:
FOUND s509 (Fable, 2026-10-06) by the review probes for s508a (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s509/review/p8/k.pl row 19); PRE-EXISTING
on main and unchanged by that batch (its `p-use-constant` gives the same answer).

REPRODUCER:
  my $f = sub { package Other; use constant A => "other-a"; package main; join " ", Other::A, Other->A };
  print $f->(), "\n";          perl: other-a other-a        PCL: dies "Undefined subroutine &Other::A called"
At file level (`package Other; use constant A => ...; package main;`) it is right.

LIKELY (not measured): the constant is defined in the package current at the START of the enclosing sub (main), not in
the package the in-body `package` statement switched to -- the family of reference_in_package_is_read_time: a package
switch inside a block must emit QUALIFIED names.  CHEAP MEASUREMENT: in the reproducer print `main->can("A") ? "in main"
: "nowhere"`.

PRIORITY: low (a package switch inside a sub body is rare; it fails LOUDLY).
subject: A `use constant` after a `package` statement INSIDE a sub body defines nothing -- `sub { package Other; use constant A => "x"; package main; Other::A }` dies "Undefined subroutine &Other::A called" (perl: x)
